description: Land Title Settlement Department - Puttalam East, Puttalam D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 41011
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels in Puttalam. It contains detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, land extents, and title classifications, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
